result.topic_en: Pencil calculations on an asymptotic expansion of a ratio of sines and of a rational function in λ (with parameter r), on locating roots of the form γλ = (π/2)s − ti, and on linear conditions for coefficients A_1, A_2, A_1' involving sin and cos of b√λ and b√(λ−2).
result.transcription:

methods.what: Transcendental equation: ratio of sines equals a rational function of λ, factored into quartic factors
Asymptotic series expansion in powers of 1/λ using the Taylor series of sin(γ/λ)
Ansatz for large complex roots and determination of the leading imaginary part
Correction term in the asymptotic root location
Linear matching conditions for coefficients and solution by determinant Π (Cramer's rule)
